top_findings.title: OTP application callback never registered, so `mix run --no-halt` starts no server
top_findings.evidence: mix.exs:4-7 has no application/0; `application: [extra_applications: [:logger], mod: {BookApi.Application, []}]` sits inside project/0, which Mix ignores for .app generation. Re-verified in a temp copy (Elixir 1.20.3): generated book_api.app has no {mod,...}; `mix run -e` printed Application.spec(:book_api, :mod)=[], Process.whereis(BookApi.Server)=nil, :gen_tcp.connect to PORT={:error,:econnrefused}
top_findings.suggestion: Add `def application, do: [extra_applications: [:logger], mod: {BookApi.Application, []}]` and remove the key from project/0
